id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

name.description: The display name of this view. This is shown to users when selecting or managing views.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

filterBarId.description: The id of the {@link UiApFilterBar} that this view is associated with.

isDefault.description: Whether this view is the default view for the {@link UiApFilterBar}.

filterValue.description:
The saved filter values for this view. This JSON object stores the state of all filters
that were applied when this view was saved, allowing users to restore the exact filtering
configuration.

columnVisibility.description:
The column visibility settings for this view. This JSON object stores which columns
are shown or hidden in the associated grid when this view is applied. Only used when
the filter bar is connected to a grid via {@link UiApFilterBar#gridId}.

title: A set of filter values and column visibility settings for a {@link UiApFilterBar}.
name: UiApFilterBar.View
